div.head: Leis Wl 39
div.ab: Ententivement se purpensent cil qui les jugementz unt a faire, que si jugent cum [il] desirent quant il dient: "Dimitte nobis debita nostra."
Those who have to give judgments shall earnestly take heed that they judge as they themselves desire when they say: "Forgive us our trespasses."
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 270–271 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
